info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Payments Payments Disputes-v3-spec
info.description: The Payment Dispute Management API enables businesses to efficiently retrieve information on payment disputes. Through this endpoint, users can access a comprehensive list of disputes related to payments, which aids in tracking and resolving conflicts. Ideal for financial institutions, payment processors, and customer support teams, this API streamlines the monitoring of payment-related issues. This enhances the overall efficiency of dispute handling processes and improves customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific payment dispute, enabling you to review its status and related information.

requestBody.description: The request body contains information necessary to query payment disputes. This typically includes filters or criteria for retrieving specific disputes.
